description.zh:
授权资源范围。取值可选范围：
- global：项目下全局资源
- custom：指定项目范围下的资源
description.en:
The scope of the authorized resources. Valid values:

- global: global resources within the project.

- custom: specified resources within the project.

description.zh: 授权规则名称，长度限制最大 64 个字符。
description.en: The name of the authorization rule. The name can be up to 64 characters long.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。
description.en: A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

title.zh: 更新一个授权规则基本信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam update-authorization-rule --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --authorization-rule-id arrule_01kf143ug06fg7m9f43u7vahxxxx --authorization-rule-name test_rule --authorization-resource-scope global --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam UpdateAuthorizationRule --region cn-hangzhou --AuthorizationResourceScope global --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --AuthorizationRuleId arrule_01kf143ug06fg7m9f43u7vahxxxx --AuthorizationRuleName test_rule --ClientToken 'client-token-example'
